Economic Impacts of Non-Native Forest Insects in the Continental United States
abstract: Reliable estimates of the impacts and costs of biological invasions are critical to developing credible management, trade and regulatory policies. Worldwide, forests and urban trees provide important ecosystem services as well as economic and social benefits, but are threatened by non-native insects. More than 450 non-native forest insects are established in the United States but estimates of broad-scale economic impacts associated with these species are largely unavailable. We developed a novel modeling approach that maximizes the use of available data, accounts for multiple sources of uncertainty, and provides cost estimates for three major feeding guilds of non-native forest insects. For each guild, we calculated the economic damages for five cost categories and we estimated the probability of future introductions of damaging pests. We found that costs are largely borne by homeowners and municipal governments. Wood- and phloem-boring insects are anticipated to cause the largest economic impacts by annually inducing nearly $1.7 billion in local government expenditures and approximately $830 million in lost residential property values. Given observations of new species, there is a 32% chance that another highly destructive borer species will invade the U.S. in the next 10 years. Our damage estimates provide a crucial but previously missing component of cost-benefit analyses to evaluate policies and management options intended to reduce species introductions. The modeling approach we developed is highly flexible and could be similarly employed to estimate damages in other countries or natural resource sectors.
abstract_zh: 对生物入侵的影响与成本作出可靠的估计，对于制定可信的管理、贸易和监管政策至关重要。在全球范围内，森林和城市树木提供着重要的生态系统服务，并带来经济和社会效益，但它们正受到外来昆虫的威胁。美国已有超过450种外来森林昆虫定居，但对于这些物种造成的大范围经济影响，目前基本缺乏估计。我们开发了一种新颖的建模方法，该方法最大限度地利用现有数据，考虑了多种不确定性来源，并为三类主要取食类群的外来森林昆虫提供了成本估计。对于每一类群，我们计算了五类成本下的经济损失，并估计了未来有害害虫入侵的概率。我们发现，成本主要由房主和市政府承担。蛀干类和韧皮部取食类昆虫预计将造成最大的经济影响，每年导致地方政府支出近17亿美元，并导致约8.3亿美元的住宅房产价值损失。根据新物种的观测情况，未来十年内另一种高度破坏性的蛀干害虫入侵美国的概率为32%。我们的损害估计为成本效益分析提供了一个至关重要却此前缺失的组成部分，可用于评估旨在减少物种引入的政策与管理选项。我们开发的建模方法具有高度的灵活性，可用于估计其他国家或自然资源部门的损害。

Preference Heterogeneity in a Count Data Model of Demand for Off-Highway Vehicle Recreation
abstract: This paper examines heterogeneity in the preferences for OHV recreation by applying the random parameters Poisson model to a data set of off-highway vehicle (OHV) users at four National Forest sites in North Carolina. The analysis develops estimates of individual consumer surplus and finds that estimates are systematically affected by the random parameter specification. There is also substantial evidence that accounting for individual heterogeneity improves the statistical fit of the models and provides a more informative description of OHV riders.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将随机参数泊松模型应用于北卡罗来纳州四个国家森林地点的越野车（OHV）用户数据集，考察了越野车休闲偏好的异质性。分析得出了个体消费者剩余的估计值，并发现这些估计值会受到随机参数设定的系统性影响。大量证据表明，考虑个体异质性可以改善模型的统计拟合，并能更为充分地描述越野车骑行者。

Forest harvesting, resource based tourism, and remoteness: An analysis of northern Ontario's sport fishing tourism
abstract: This paper assesses the impact that the routine application of Ontario's forest management planning process has on the revenue generation of sport fishing tourism sites. The analysis employs a hedonic pricing model to examine jointly these effects on revenue for three tourism experiences. These tourism experiences offer different degrees of remoteness, and as a consequence, require different levels of effort and cost to visit. Modelling the relationship between price and attributes of sites such as remoteness permits the analysis to forecast the revenue generation potential of sport fishing tourism sites under a range of forest management schemes. The results show that the extent of forest harvesting had no statistical relationship with prices charged for fishing packages at road-, boat-, or train-accessible sites and a negative but small impact on the prices charged for fishing packages at sites accessible by float plane.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了安大略省森林管理规划过程的常规实施对垂钓旅游景点收入所产生的影响。分析采用享乐价格模型，联合考察了这些影响对三种旅游体验收入的作用。这三种旅游体验的偏远程度各不相同，因此到达的难度和所需的成本也各不相同。通过对景点价格与偏远程度等属性之间的关系进行建模，本文能够预测垂钓旅游景点在多种森林管理方案下的收入潜力。结果表明，森林采伐的程度与公路、船只或火车可达景点的垂钓套餐价格之间没有统计上的显著关系；而对于只能通过水上飞机抵达的景点，采伐程度与垂钓套餐价格之间存在负向但影响较小的关系。

Backcountry recreationist's valuation of forest and park management features in wilderness parks of the Western Canadian Shield
venue: The New Economics of Outdoor Recreation
abstract: The economic value of four forest ecosystems, fire-damaged forests, cut blocks, and several park management features was estimated for backcountry recreationists, primarily canoeists, in Nopiming Provincial Park in eastern Manitoba. The analysis was conducted using the travel cost random utility model. It revealed that the forest ecosystems associated with jack pine (Pinusbanksiana Lamb.) and white spruce (Piceaglauca (Moench) Voss) were valued by recreationists. On the other hand, the analysis predicted that recreationists would pay to avoid black spruce (Piceamariana (Mill.) BSP) and aspen (Populustremuloides Michx.) ecosystems, fire-damaged forests, portages, and cottages. The results provide weak statistical evidence that cut blocks that are not in the line of site of recreationists provide positive benefits. While park management variables play a role in determining recreation values, the ages and types of forests located at recreation sites are more important. These findings support a major role for fire in determining recreation economic benefit flows from forests in the Canadian Shield.
abstract_zh: 本文测算了四类森林生态系统（火灾受损森林、采伐区）以及若干公园管理特征对荒野休闲者（主要是独木舟爱好者）的经济价值，研究地点为加拿大马尼托巴省东部的诺皮明省立公园。分析采用旅行成本随机效用模型。结果表明，与乔松（Pinus banksiana Lamb.）和白云杉（Picea glauca (Moench) Voss）相关的森林生态系统受到休闲者的重视。另一方面，分析预测休闲者愿意支付费用以避开黑云杉（Picea mariana (Mill.) BSP）和颤杨（Populus tremuloides Michx.）生态系统、火灾受损森林、搬运小道和小屋。有弱统计证据表明，不在休闲者视线范围内的采伐区也能带来正向效益。尽管公园管理变量在决定休闲价值方面发挥一定作用，但休闲地点森林的树龄和类型更为重要。这些发现表明，火灾在决定加拿大地盾区森林所产生的休闲经济效益流方面起着主要作用。

title: Application of Computable General Equilibrium Model to Evaluate Surface Water Reallocation Policies
abstract: This study uses a computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to calculate the economic impacts of reallocating surface water from irrigated agriculture to recreational use at the Stillwater National Wildlife Refuge in Churchill County, Nevada. In this study, we consider three alternative assumptions about how the proceeds from water rights sales are spent. Model results show that under all three alternative assumptions, the combined effect of water rights compensation and the increase in recreation-related expenditures does not offset the reduction in agricultural production.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，计算将地表水从灌溉农业重新分配给内华达州丘吉尔县斯蒂尔沃特国家野生动物保护区休闲用途所产生的经济影响。本研究考虑了关于水权出售收益如何使用的三种替代假设。模型结果表明，在这三种假设下，水权补偿与休闲相关支出增加的综合效应，均不足以抵消农业产量的减少。

title: Welfare Effects of Changes in Environmental Quality Under Individual Uncertainty About Use
abstract: We adapt the theoretical state-preference model to value nonmarket public goods under individual uncertainty about use, illustrating with an assessment of willingness-to-pay to prevent acid rain lake damage in the northeast. Individual usage uncertainty is modeled via probabilities of participation in trout fishing. Changes in environmental quality are valued using a random utility model to explain yes/no responses to a contingent valuation question. We produce quantitative welfare measures: individual fitted and simulated passive- and active-use values, individual expected consumer surplus, option price, option value, and complete individual willingness-to-pay loci.
abstract_zh: 我们调整了理论上的状态偏好模型，以在个体对使用情况存在不确定性的条件下评估非市场公共物品。我们以评估东北部地区为防止酸雨对湖泊造成损害而愿意支付的费用为例进行说明。个体使用的不确定性通过参与鳟鱼垂钓的概率来建模。环境质量的变化通过随机效用模型进行估价，该模型用于解释对条件价值评估问题的“是/否”回答。我们得出了定量的福利指标：个体拟合与模拟的被动使用价值和主动使用价值、个体期望消费者剩余、选择价格、选择价值，以及完整的个体支付意愿轨迹。

Valuing the Impacts of Forest Fires on Backcountry Forest Recreation
abstract: A discrete choice travel cost model was developed for backcountry forest recreation using 2 yr of backcountry canoe registrations from Nopiming Park, Manitoba. A statistically significant variable explaining choice of route was the amount of forest along the route that was burned in the last 10 yr; virtually all of which occurred in two particularly severe fires during 1983. The current economic welfare loss from these fires was estimated using a discrete choice travel cost model combined with a count model of trip demand. Since the forest grows back following fire, these losses will eventually decrease to zero. A linear intertemporal damage function for one of the fires is estimated, and the present value of damages under alternative discount rate assumptions is presented. For. Sci. 42(4):450-455.
abstract_zh: 我们利用来自马尼托巴省诺皮明公园两年的荒野独木舟登记数据，建立了一个用于荒野森林休闲的离散选择旅行成本模型。一个具有统计显著性的、用于解释路线选择的变量，是路线沿线在过去10年内被烧毁的森林面积；而这些烧毁几乎全部发生在1983年的两场特别严重的火灾中。我们利用离散选择旅行成本模型结合出游需求的计数模型，估计了这些火灾造成的当前经济福利损失。由于森林在火灾后会重新生长，这些损失最终将降至零。我们估计了其中一场火灾的线性跨期损害函数，并给出了在不同贴现率假设下损害的现值。For. Sci. 42(4):450-455。

title: Global Climate Change and Optimal Forest Management
abstract: A policy question of current interest is how to cope with climate change. One suggestion is to use forests to offset carbon emissions, and therefore, reduce the threat of global warming. This study develops a rigorous model of the relationship between optimal forest harvesting regimes and carbon sequestration. The theoretical analysis integrates the carbon sequestration life cycle into the Faustmann framework and develops optimal cutting rules when carbon sequestration benefits are considered. The carbon life cycle includes both the sequestration of carbon and its ultimate re‐release into the atmosphere. A case study of Douglas fir applies the theoretical framework.
abstract_zh: 一个当前备受关注的政策问题是如何应对气候变化。一种建议是利用森林抵消碳排放，从而降低全球变暖的威胁。本研究建立了一个严谨的模型，用以刻画最优森林采伐制度与碳汇之间的关系。理论分析将碳的生命周期纳入Faustmann框架，并在考虑碳汇效益的情况下推导出最优采伐规则。碳的生命周期既包括碳的吸收，也包括其最终重新释放到大气中的过程。我们以花旗松为案例，应用了该理论框架。
